beginner.title: Get started with Avast
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Avast, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Set it up right
beginner.outcome: You can: install and configure Avast
beginner.practice: Set up Avast and store recovery details safely

beginner.title: Everyday use
beginner.outcome: You can: use Avast without friction
beginner.practice: Use Avast for a week on your main accounts

intermediate.title: Protect what matters most
intermediate.outcome: You can: secure your critical accounts

intermediate.title: Spot scams
intermediate.outcome: You can: recognise phishing and fraud

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Avast
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Avast distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Avast
expert.outcome: You can: use Avast's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Help family or team
expert.outcome: You can: roll out good security habits to others
expert.practice: Help two people set up Avast

expert.title: Integrate Avast into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Avast with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Avast to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Avast well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Avast" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
